# Digilent PS/2 modules

`MouseCTL.vhd` and `PS2Interface.vhd` provide the mouse controller and bidirectional PS/2 interface used by this project.

The source files identify Ulrich Zoltan as their author and Digilent, Inc. as the 2006 copyright holder. The original headers have been preserved. These modules are separated from the project-specific VHDL so their origin is clear.

The project report references Digilent's Nexys A7 mouse-controller source as the upstream implementation.
